neighbours.label: an ease-or-frequency modifier describing a symptom tendency (easily distracted, easy bruising, frequent infections)
fire: Children with the condition are often easily distracted and restless in class.
Warning signs include easy bruising and bleeding from the gums.
Patients may notice frequent infections that take weeks to clear.
Common symptoms are fatigue, rapid weight loss and blurred vision.
Older dogs with the disease become easily tired on short walks.
People with low platelets often report easy bleeding after small cuts.
The main signs are fever, a fast heartbeat and heavy sweating.
Some sufferers are easily startled by sudden noises at night.
quiet: Children with the condition are often restless and talkative in class.
Warning signs include dark bruises and bleeding from the gums.
Patients may notice painful infections that take weeks to clear.
Common symptoms are fatigue, weight loss and blurred vision.
Older dogs with the disease become very tired on short walks.
People with low platelets often report heavy bleeding after small cuts.
The main signs are fever, a pounding heartbeat and heavy sweating.
Some sufferers are badly frightened by sudden noises at night.

notes: card: ' easily' x7, ' easy', ' Rapid', ' fast', ' frequent' in symptom lists; logit suppresses quick/quickly/easily. Near misses keep symptom lists with other modifiers.
